proves.claim: A red gate's show lines print the command the failing phase ran as one command line under GATE_RED, and print none for a phase that carries no command.

cli.logic-show-gate.red-line-prints-phas.why: Without it, a builder cannot see that the proof ran a different command from the one the gate judged.

proves.claim: The pulled gate job script records the command a failing phase ran on that phase's receipt row.

cli.io-submit-pull-phase-command.runner-.why: Without it, the receipt names no command, so show and the refusal have nothing to print.
